name: @oneworks/model-protocol
description: Protocol-safe model request and response translation for One Works

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.js
scripts.test: pnpm -C ../.. exec vitest run --workspace vitest.workspace.ts --project bundler packages/model-protocol/__tests__
